claims.evidence: Photo 0 panel clearly shows the brand and model name.
The witness report notes that functional status, sound output, and the display's operation were not shown.
The witness observed a thin dark vertical line across the keys on the left side, indicating wear or damage.

risks.risk: Dead or unresponsive keys (common in older PSR models)
risks.proof: A video clip of a hand playing a chromatic scale across all 61 keys to hear every note.
risks.if_unproven: as having multiple dead keys requiring contact cleaning or repair

risks.risk: LCD screen failure or missing segments
risks.proof: A clear photo of the central LCD screen while the device is powered on.

risks.risk: Faulty power port or internal board damage
risks.proof: A video showing the device being powered on via the DC input and playing sound.
A video with audio at high volume demonstrating clear sound from both speakers.
risks.if_unproven: as having damaged speakers requiring external output

proof_requests: Video of the keyboard powered on and every key being played.
Photo of the rear connection ports to check for physical damage.
Photo of the power adapter (if included) or the battery compartment.
Close-up photo of the 'dark vertical line' on the keys to determine if it is a crack or a stain.
response.reason: The identity of the item is confirmed as a Yamaha PSR-175. It can be priced at its worst-case (used, unverified functional status, and visible key damage) until the seller provides proof of 'perfect' operation.
